policy_structure.family_structure_descri.text: Family Structure : Self + Spouse + 2 Dependent children

hospitalization.room_rent.room_rent_norm.text: If the Insured Member is admitted in a room where the room rent incurred is higher than the room rent limit specified above, then the Insured Member shall bear the ratable proportion of the total Medical Expenses in the proportion of the room rent actually incurred- room rent limit/room rent actually incurred.

hospitalization.room_rent.room_rent_icu.text: If the Insured Member is admitted in a room where the room rent incurred is higher than the room rent limit specified above, then the Insured Member shall bear the ratable proportion of the total Medical Expenses in the proportion of the room rent actually incurred- room rent limit/room rent actually incurred.

hospitalization.pre_hospitalization_days.text: Pre & Post Hospitalization is covered for 30 days and 60 days respectively.

hospitalization.post_hospitalization_day.text: Pre & Post Hospitalization is covered for 30 days and 60 days respectively.

maternity.waiting_period_9_month.text: 9 month waiting period in respect of maternity claims waived for all Insured Members.

maternity.baby_day_one_cover.text: New Born Baby covered from day one within family floater Sum Insured.

maternity.normal_delivery_limit.text: Maximum Limit for Maternity claims is Rs. 50,000 for Normal and Rs. 50,000 for LSCS

maternity.c_section_limit.text: Maximum Limit for Maternity claims is Rs. 50,000 for Normal and Rs. 50,000 for LSCS

waiting_periods.initial_30_day.text: 30 Days Wait Period condition is waived for existing members and new joinees.

waiting_periods.first_second_year.text: First & Second year exclusion condition for specific diseases is waived for all Insured Members.

waiting_periods.pre_existing_disease.text: Pre-existing diseases are covered for existing members and new joinees.
